title: COSMIC Plan Document
description: Simplified COSMIC plan-phase artifact schema migrated from cosmic-claude assets/schemas/plan.json

totalCfps.description: Sum of all estimatedCfps; must equal the sum of functions[].estimatedCfps

funcId.description: Function ID: segments separated by hyphens, each segment 1-8 chars (A-Z, 0-9), at least as many segments as the effective param moduleLevels; the segments are the module code chain of the changed module

l2Name.description: Level 2 function name (required when the effective param moduleLevels >= 2; enforced by rule plan/name-hierarchy)

l3Name.description: Level 3 function name (required when the effective param moduleLevels = 3; enforced by rule plan/name-hierarchy)

funcDesc.description: Function description; content-quality minimum length (80) is enforced by rule plan/func-desc-min-length

estimatedCfps.description: Estimated CFP count for this function (hard bounds 10-100, recommended 20-50)

changeKind.description: Whether this function adds a new module or modifies an existing one; every added-or-modified leaf module is exactly one function (rule plan/context-alignment reconciles the module code against the upstream context)
